افتقدوا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَقَدُوا (iftaqadū) /if.ta.qa.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# اُفْتُقِدُوا (uftuqidū) /uf.tu.qi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# اِفْتَقِدُوا (iftaqidū) /if.ta.qi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
